name: White Monuments of Vladimir and Suzdal
description: In Vladimir Oblast, east of Moscow, the old towns of Vladimir and Suzdal keep eight medieval monuments built of pale limestone in the late 12th and early 13th centuries. The group includes churches, a monastery, a castle and a gate. The highlights are Vladimir's Cathedral of the Assumption and the Church of St Demetrios, whose walls are covered in finely carved stone figures.
